sos.wv.gov.en: the West Virginia Secretary of State
sos.wv.gov.es: la Secretaría de Estado de West Virginia

reg_deadline.en: Registration closed Tuesday, October 13, 2026. Not sure you're registered? Check your record at GoVoteWV.
reg_deadline.es: El registro cerró el martes 13 de octubre de 2026. ¿No sabes si estás registrado? Revisa tu registro en GoVoteWV.

mail_request.en: If you qualify to vote absentee, your county clerk must receive your application by Wednesday, October 28, 2026. Send it by mail, email or fax, or bring it in person.
mail_request.es: Si puedes votar en ausencia, el secretario de tu condado (county clerk) debe recibir tu solicitud a más tardar el miércoles 28 de octubre de 2026. Mándala por correo postal, correo electrónico o fax, o llévala en persona.
mail_request.quote: October 28, 2026 — Deadline for Absentee Ballot Applications ... October 27 – Noon, November 3, 2026 — Emergency Absentee Voting — Registered voters and other qualified voters in the county may be eligible to receive an emergency absentee ballot in the following circumstances: Voter is in the hospital on Election Day; Voter is a replacement poll worker appointed after the period for Early Voting; ... or Voter becomes confined, on or after the seventh day preceding an election, to a specific location within the county because of illness, injury, physical disability, or immobility due to advanced age or other medical reason (county policy required).
mail_request.en_after: Applications closed October 28. In the hospital, or confined in your county since October 27 by illness, injury, disability or advanced age? Call your county clerk about an emergency absentee ballot by noon on Election Day. Some options depend on county policy.
mail_request.es_after: Las solicitudes cerraron el 28 de octubre. ¿Estás en el hospital, o desde el 27 de octubre no puedes salir de un lugar en tu condado por enfermedad, lesión, discapacidad o edad avanzada? Llama al secretario de tu condado (county clerk) para pedir una boleta de voto en ausencia de emergencia antes del mediodía del Día de las Elecciones. Algunas opciones dependen de las reglas de cada condado.

mail_return.en: By hand: at your county clerk's office by Monday, November 2. No one can hand-deliver more than two voters' ballots. By mail: it counts if your clerk receives it by Wednesday, November 4, or if it's postmarked by Tuesday, November 3, and arrives before canvass starts on Monday, November 9.
mail_return.es: En persona: en la oficina del secretario de tu condado (county clerk) a más tardar el lunes 2 de noviembre. Nadie puede entregar en persona las boletas de más de dos votantes. Por correo: cuenta si el secretario la recibe a más tardar el miércoles 4 de noviembre, o si tiene matasellos del martes 3 de noviembre o antes y llega antes de que empiece el escrutinio (canvass) el lunes 9 de noviembre.
mail_return.quote: (g) Except as provided in subsection (h) of this section, absentee ballots returned by United States mail or other express shipping service are to be accepted if: (1) The ballot is received by the official designated to supervise and conduct absentee voting no later than the day after the election; or (2) The ballot bears a postmark of the United States Postal Service dated no later than election day and the ballot is received by the official designated to supervise and conduct absentee voting no later than the hour at which the board of canvassers convenes to begin the canvass. ... (k) Absentee ballots which are hand delivered are to be accepted if they are received by the official designated to supervise and conduct absentee voting no later than the day preceding the election: Provided , That no person may hand deliver more than two absentee ballots in any election
mail_return.en_after: By mail: it counts if your county clerk receives it by Wednesday, November 4, or if it's postmarked by Tuesday, November 3, and arrives before canvass starts on Monday, November 9. Hand delivery closed November 2.
mail_return.es_after: Por correo: cuenta si el secretario de tu condado (county clerk) la recibe a más tardar el miércoles 4 de noviembre, o si tiene matasellos del martes 3 de noviembre o antes y llega antes de que empiece el escrutinio (canvass) el lunes 9 de noviembre. La entrega en persona cerró el 2 de noviembre.

early_hours.en: Early voting runs Wednesday, October 21 to Saturday, October 31, 2026, during normal business hours. Both Saturdays, October 24 and October 31, sites are open 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.
early_hours.es: La votación anticipada va del miércoles 21 al sábado 31 de octubre de 2026, en horario normal de oficina. Los dos sábados, 24 y 31 de octubre, los centros abren de 9 a. m. a 5 p. m.
early_hours.quote: October 21 – October 31, 2026 — Early Voting in Person — Voter may vote an early ballot at the county courthouse, an annex or a designated community voting location during normal business hours. Early voting must be conducted between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. on the last 2 Saturdays before the General Election.
early_hours.en_after: Early voting ended October 31. On Election Day, vote at your assigned polling place, 6:30 a.m. to 7:30 p.m.
early_hours.es_after: La votación anticipada terminó el 31 de octubre. El Día de las Elecciones, vota en el lugar que te corresponde, de 6:30 a. m. a 7:30 p. m.

cure.notes: No absentee ballot cure process or deadline found on sos.wv.gov.

in_person.en: Vote early at your county courthouse, an annex or a community voting site October 21 to 31. On Election Day, you must vote at your assigned polling place.
in_person.es: Vota por anticipado en el juzgado de tu condado (county courthouse), en un anexo o en un centro de votación comunitario del 21 al 31 de octubre. El Día de las Elecciones tienes que votar en el lugar de votación que te corresponde.
in_person.quote: Remember that on Election Day you must vote at your assigned polling location.
in_person.en_after: Early voting ended October 31. On Election Day, you must vote at your assigned polling place.
in_person.es_after: La votación anticipada terminó el 31 de octubre. El Día de las Elecciones tienes que votar en el lugar de votación que te corresponde.

first_time.en: Voting for the first time in West Virginia or your county, and didn't show ID when you registered? Bring a document with your current name and address: a photo ID, a utility bill, a bank statement, a government check, a paycheck or another government document. Voting absentee? Put a copy in the return envelope, outside the secrecy envelope.
first_time.es: ¿Votas por primera vez en West Virginia o en tu condado y no mostraste identificación al registrarte? Lleva un documento con tu nombre y dirección actuales: una identificación con foto, un recibo de servicios, un estado de cuenta bancario, un cheque del gobierno, un talón de pago u otro documento del gobierno. ¿Votas en ausencia? Pon una copia en el sobre de devolución, fuera del sobre de privacidad.
first_time.quote: First-time voters who did not provide ID when registering must show an approved form of ID as listed in the First-Time Voter ID Requirements section. ... Valid ID for first-time voters — only the following documents showing your current name and address can be accepted: Valid Photo Identification Utility Bill Bank Statement Government Check Paycheck Any Other Official Government Document

locator_label.en: Find Your Polling Place (West Virginia Secretary of State)
locator_label.es: Búsqueda de tu lugar de votación (Secretaría de Estado de West Virginia)

rule.en: Look up your Election Day polling place with the state's search. Early voting sites and hours for all 55 counties are on the Secretary of State's early voting locations page.
rule.es: Busca tu lugar de votación del Día de las Elecciones en la herramienta del estado. Los centros y horarios de votación anticipada de los 55 condados están en la página de lugares de votación anticipada de la Secretaría de Estado.
rule.quote: Early voting locations are listed below for all 55 West Virginia counties.

en: West Virginia driver's license or state-issued ID
Government employee ID with photo, from a local, state or federal government
Student ID with photo from a West Virginia college or high school
Voter registration card with photo from a West Virginia county clerk or the Secretary of State
DMV ID without a photo, for voters whose recognized religious community forbids being photographed
es: Licencia de conducir o identificación estatal de West Virginia
Licencia de conducir de otro estado
Pasaporte o tarjeta pasaporte de EE. UU.
Identificación de empleado del gobierno con foto, local, estatal o federal
Identificación de estudiante con foto de una universidad o preparatoria de West Virginia
Identificación militar de EE. UU. con foto
Tarjeta de registro de votante con foto de la oficina del secretario de un condado de West Virginia o de la Secretaría de Estado
Identificación del DMV sin foto, para votantes cuya comunidad religiosa reconocida les prohíbe tomarse fotos
accepted.quote: West Virginia voters must show an approved form of photo identification at the polls during early voting or on Election Day.

expired.en: Your ID must be current. If you're 65 or older, an expired ID still works if it was still valid on your 65th birthday.
expired.es: Tu identificación debe estar vigente. Si tienes 65 años o más, una identificación vencida todavía sirve si estaba vigente el día que cumpliste 65.
expired.quote: Of the IDs listed above, if the voter is 65 years of age or older and the ID is expired, it is still acceptable if the document was not expired on their 65th birthday.

without.en: No ID? An adult who has known you for at least six months can sign an affidavit and show a valid photo ID with their current name and address. A poll worker who has known you that long can also confirm who you are. If neither applies, you vote a provisional ballot. You can get a free voter ID card at your county clerk's office.
without.es: ¿No tienes identificación? Un adulto que te conozca desde hace por lo menos seis meses puede firmar una declaración jurada y mostrar una identificación con foto vigente con su nombre y dirección actuales. Un trabajador electoral que te conozca desde hace ese tiempo también puede confirmar quién eres. Si ninguna de estas opciones aplica, votas con una boleta provisional. Puedes sacar gratis una tarjeta de identificación de votante en la oficina del secretario de tu condado (county clerk).
without.quote: Signed, Sworn Statement by an Adult Must have known the voter for at least six (6) months. Must show a valid photo ID with current name and address. Must sign an affidavit confirming the voter's identity. A Poll Worker Knows the Voter Must have known the voter for at least six (6) months. ... What if a voter with no ID doesn't fall under any exemptions? The voter will vote a provisional ballot at the polls. ... Registered voters can receive a free voter ID card by submitting an application in person at their county clerk's office.

who.en: You can vote absentee by mail only if you can't vote in person during all of early voting and on Election Day, for a reason the law allows, such as:
who.es: Puedes votar en ausencia por correo solo si no puedes votar en persona durante toda la votación anticipada ni el Día de las Elecciones, por una razón que permite la ley, como:
who.quote: A registered voter may vote an absentee ballot by mail if the voter is “confined,” or not in their home county, for the entire duration of in-person voting (both the early voting period and on Election Day), for one of the many reasons and excuses allowed by law.

en: illness, injury or another medical reason
a disability or advanced age that keeps you from getting around
incarceration or home detention, unless you're serving a sentence for a felony, treason or election bribery
your work hours and distance from the county seat
an early voting site and polling place you can't get into
attending college or another school or training
serving as an elected or appointed state or federal official
es: enfermedad, lesión u otra razón médica
una discapacidad o edad avanzada que no te deja moverte
estar en la cárcel o en arresto domiciliario, a menos que cumplas una condena por un delito grave (felony), traición o soborno electoral
tu horario de trabajo y la distancia a la cabecera del condado
un centro de votación anticipada y un lugar de votación a los que no tienes acceso
un viaje personal o de negocios
estudiar en la universidad u otra escuela o capacitación
vivir por ahora fuera del condado
ser funcionario estatal o federal, electo o designado
who_list.quote: Voters not able to vote in person during Early Voting or Election Day due to one of the following circumstances may vote an absentee ballot by mail:

witness.notes: The ballot instructions (paper and optical scan) are separate documents that were not read.

dropbox.notes: No drop boxes mentioned on sos.wv.gov; return is by mail or hand delivery to the county clerk.

gear.en: On Election Day, no one may display signs or other campaign items, hand out literature or ask for votes inside the polling place or within 100 feet of the building's outside entrance. The same applies at early voting sites while voting is going on. A bumper sticker or sign on your car is allowed while you're parked there to vote or to drive someone to vote.
gear.es: El Día de las Elecciones, nadie puede mostrar letreros u otros artículos de campaña, repartir propaganda ni pedir votos dentro del lugar de votación ni a menos de 100 pies de la entrada exterior del edificio. Lo mismo aplica en los lugares de votación anticipada mientras se está votando. Se permite una calcomanía o un letrero en tu carro mientras estás estacionado ahí para votar o para llevar a alguien a votar.
gear.quote: “Electioneering” does not include ... bumper stickers or signs affixed to a person’s vehicle which is parked within or passing through a distance of one hundred feet of the entrance to a polling place while such person is voting or transporting any voter to the polls. ... No person may do any electioneering on election day within any polling place, or within one hundred feet of the outside entrance to the building housing the polling place.

phone.en: Don't take a phone or camera into the voting booth to record your vote. West Virginia law bars entering the booth with any recording or electronic device to record or interfere with voting. The law doesn't address other photos in the polling place, so ask a poll worker first.
phone.es: No entres a la cabina de votación con un teléfono o una cámara para grabar tu voto. La ley de West Virginia prohíbe entrar a la cabina con cualquier aparato de grabación o electrónico para grabar o interferir con la votación. La ley no habla de otras fotos en el lugar de votación, así que pregunta primero a un trabajador electoral.
phone.quote: No person may enter a voting booth with any recording or electronic device in order to record or interfere with the voting process.

line.en: If you're in line when the polls close, stay in line. You can still vote.
line.es: Si estás en la fila cuando cierran las casillas, no te salgas. Todavía puedes votar.
line.quote: The election commissioner shall permit those electors to vote who are present at the polling place prior to the hour specified for the closing of the polls: Provided, That at that time they are in a line awaiting their turn to vote within the voting room itself or, if the line extends outside of the voting room itself, within that line.

tradition.en: West Virginia held its first statewide I Voted! sticker contest in 2026, and more than 1,100 eighth graders entered. Voters picked the statewide winner from four regional winners: a design by Reese, an eighth grader at Shady Spring Middle School in Raleigh County. Raleigh County's clerk received 11,000 of her stickers to hand out to in-person voters in the May primary.
tradition.es: West Virginia hizo su primer concurso estatal de stickers "I Voted!" en 2026, y participaron más de 1,100 estudiantes de octavo grado. Los votantes eligieron al ganador estatal entre cuatro ganadores regionales: un diseño de Reese, estudiante de octavo grado de Shady Spring Middle School, en el condado de Raleigh. El secretario del condado de Raleigh recibió 11,000 de sus stickers para repartirlos a quienes votaron en persona en las primarias de mayo.
tradition.quote: With the support of the state's county clerks, more than 1,100 eighth grade student artists entered the contest. ... Secretary Warner announced that Reese Childers, a student at Shady Spring Middle School in Raleigh County (her design is above), was selected by the voters to be the 2026 Statewide Winner. ... Raleigh County Clerk Scott Van Meter was presented with 11,000 stickers featuring Reese's design to be handed out to Raleigh County voters who vote in-person in the Primary Election.

provisional.en: If poll workers can't find your name in the poll book, or there's another question about whether you can vote, they must offer you a provisional ballot. It counts if the Board of Canvassers finds you're eligible and registered.
provisional.es: Si los trabajadores electorales no encuentran tu nombre en el registro de votantes, o hay otra duda sobre si puedes votar, tienen que ofrecerte una boleta provisional. Cuenta si la junta de escrutinio (Board of Canvassers) determina que tienes derecho a votar y estás registrado.
provisional.quote: If you vote a provisional ballot for any other reason, and the Board of Canvassers find that you are eligible and registered, your ballot will be counted.

line.en: You can still vote. Anyone in line at the polling place when the polls close gets to vote, even if the line runs outside.
line.es: Igual puedes votar. Toda persona que esté en la fila del lugar de votación cuando cierran las casillas puede votar, aunque la fila llegue hasta afuera.
line.quote: The election commissioner shall permit those electors to vote who are present at the polling place prior to the hour specified for the closing of the polls: Provided, That at that time they are in a line awaiting their turn to vote within the voting room itself or, if the line extends outside of the voting room itself, within that line.

track.en: Look up your absentee ballot's status with the Secretary of State's absentee ballot tracker.
track.es: Revisa el estado de tu boleta de voto en ausencia en la herramienta de seguimiento de la Secretaría de Estado (Absentee Ballot Tracking).
track.quote: Absentee voters may conveniently track the status of their absentee ballots by entering the requested information at the following link: Absentee Ballot Tracking.

late_mail.en: A mailed absentee ballot counts if your county clerk receives it by Wednesday, November 4. A later one counts if it's postmarked by November 3 and arrives before canvass starts on Monday, November 9.
late_mail.es: Una boleta de voto en ausencia enviada por correo cuenta si el secretario de tu condado (county clerk) la recibe a más tardar el miércoles 4 de noviembre. Una que llegue después cuenta si tiene matasellos del 3 de noviembre o antes y llega antes de que empiece el escrutinio (canvass) el lunes 9 de noviembre.
late_mail.quote: November 4, 2026 — Absentee Ballots without Postmark Accepted November 9, 2026 — Absentee Ballots Postmarked by Election Day Accepted

notes: Read October 21, 2026 on sos.wv.gov (GoVoteWV 2026 General Election calendar, be-registered-and-ready, elections FAQ, absentee-voting-information, the absentee eligibility PDF at /media/359, early-voting-locations, the March 11, 2026 sticker contest release) and code.wvlegislature.gov (3-1-31 hours, 3-1-34 ID, 3-1-41 provisional, 3-9-9 electioneering). EARLY VOTING for states.js: Wednesday, October 21 to Saturday, October 31, 2026. GoVoteWV quote: 'October 21 – October 31, 2026 — Early Voting in Person — Voter may vote an early ballot at the county courthouse, an annex or a designated community voting location during normal business hours. Early voting must be conducted between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. on the last 2 Saturdays before the General Election.' Early voting locations page: 'Early Voting Dates: October 21–31, 2026' (https://sos.wv.gov/early-voting-locations). CONFLICT on a provisional ballot cast for lack of ID: the elections FAQ says 'If you vote a provisional ballot because you did not show ID, just present your ID at your County Clerk's Office before canvass and your ballot will be counted', while the ID page says 'Before canvass, the provisional ballot signature is compared to the voter's registration signature. If the signatures match, the vote should count at canvass.' W. Va. Code 3-1-34(a)(6)(A) matches the ID page ('The provisional ballot may be counted once the election authority verifies the identity of the individual by comparing that individual's signature to the current signature on file'). So id.without leaves out the provisional path, and faq.provisional gives only the general rule. The docs/faq-sources.json WV id summary ('show ID before canvass') follows the FAQ wording; the live faq_text answer ('Without one, you vote a provisional ballot') is still accurate. Sample ballot lookup is at wv.omniballot.us (vendor, linked from GoVoteWV); not used. Canvass date: November 9 is from the GoVoteWV calendar.

hours.en: Polling places are open 6:30 a.m. to 7:30 p.m. local time.
hours.es: Los lugares de votación abren de 6:30 a. m. a 7:30 p. m., hora local.
hours.quote: polls shall be opened in each precinct on the day of the election at 6:30 in the morning and be closed at 7:30 in the evening.
